overview.description: The Tema Trading & Prediction Markets ETF (DICE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in financials equity. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of domestic and foreign Trading and Prediction Markets companies. The portfolio expects to hold at least 15 to 100 constituents, from micro- to large-cap firms, in seeking long-term growth. DICE was launched on Sep 8, 2026 and is issued by Tema.

data.title: Novel ETFs: New Strategies Push Boundaries
data.text: As ETF strategies continue to expand into new asset classes and structures, the SEC has been taking a closer look at how some of these products fit within existing regulations.

data.title: Tema Launches Trading & Prediction Markets ETF (DICE)
data.text: NEW YORK, Sept. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Tema ETFs (“Tema”), a leader in actively managed exchange-traded funds, today announced the launch of the Tema Trading & Prediction Markets ETF (DICE).
